behavior.line_coordination: Main-thread LinePrompt borrows the invocation I/O context and input controller. Resolved native stdout/stderr destinations matching the input terminal invalidate the visible line, including raw echo and failed prompt attempts. Display, file notice and recovery writers share that observer; prompt/echo writes are guarded against recursion. Redirected logs do not invalidate the input terminal. Outer event batches and real input boundaries restore the prompt plus surviving raw draft once.
behavior.prompt_policy: During active work: requests, discard acknowledgement or a live ordinary draft only. Empty idle input belongs to libedit; stale-line acknowledgement returns ownership to libedit. No empty steering prompt at turn start or between progress records.
behavior.discard: Unfinished input discarded. identifies stale-line acknowledgement. Request expired; answer discarded. identifies a completed rejected/mismatched answer. Rejected answers never become messages.
behavior.width: Reject invalid, disabled-Unicode or strictly invisible tokens before locale width conversion. Public interfaces and output bytes remain unchanged.

static_analysis.interpretation: Local Clang findings exactly equal the previously recorded baseline: five source warnings, one SDK13-incomplete translation unit and the context division warning. Required Ubuntu Clang analysis passes. No required checks or suppressions were weakened.

failure_evidence.issue: Idle stale-input acknowledgement did not hand control back to libedit; full Debug and sanitizer integrations failed the existing prompt-restoration assertions for both approval and question expiry.
New PTY callbacks did not bind loop variables; pinned Ruff B023 rejected them.
Strict Release baseline fails existing images.cpp integer-to-double conversion warnings on the local Apple compiler.
failure_evidence.handling: Identical benchmark-only warning settings on every variant; required Debug, sanitizer, lint and analysis settings unchanged.

performance.method: Identical Release harnesses, 262144-byte production budget, one warm-up and five alternating measured runs in each of two sets, without concurrent task tests/analyzers. C++ allocations and direct native calls only; not peak RSS or complete libc activity.
performance.counter_checks: Allocation, locale-conversion, write/stat/flags/pipe-bound positive controls pass. Checksums match. Diagnostics and exports have equal allocation and directly observed native-operation counts across variants. Unchanged cached redraws prepare zero source bytes.
performance.retained: Lazy width conversion removes 100000 unnecessary mbrtowc calls per targeted workload with zero new allocations; both targeted median sets improve.
performance.omitted: First in-loop trim tracker regressed small presentations. Guaranteed-fit specialization improves large presentation modes, but small-file exports are 6.74%/5.32% slower than width-only in the final two sets. Omitted under the no-repeatable-unrelated-regression gate; the existing bounded trimming traversal remains.
performance.final_source_note: Measured mandatory CLI overlay precedes the one-line idle-discard handoff correction fb2d812. That correction is outside the cached-input, rendering, native-output and headless-export paths measured here. Final inline rendering headers and benchmark harnesses match the published hashes. The final handoff and callbacks are covered by both full suites, 20 repetitions and required Ubuntu CI. No end-to-end line-editor or general latency claim.
